skill_name: Compare and contrast the economic consequences of supply-side and demand-side economic policies
workflow: Supply-side economic policies focus on increasing the productive capacity of the economy, usually through tax cuts and deregulation, while demand-side economic policies focus on increasing the aggregate demand for goods and services through government spending and triggering consumption by cutting taxes and interest rates.
